finding: The direct Feishu push source check verified publication, decision hashes, approval status and six remote review receipts, but did not require either Paper execution receipt/account for that version.
risk: A caller could create a delivery intent and send a reviewed card before deterministic dual-Paper finalization, making the message look more complete than the business chain.

regression.red: After six accepted local review-contract steps but before Paper settlement, push reached the notification configuration reader instead of rejecting missing Paper evidence.
regression.green: The direct push source check reuses the existing dual-account Paper evidence verifier before reading notification credentials or creating the outbox intent.
regression.one_account_tamper: Changing no_gate execution_receipts.plan_hash blocks push before credential read and outbox creation, despite gate account and all reviews remaining valid.
regression.unknown_delivery: The isolated end-to-end notification retry fixture now first finishes the session and both Paper accounts; lost provider response still yields one send attempt and no blind retry.

registered_backup_boundary: The latest registered snapshot c508038af1414b5c92fbfa163f83efae predates this change. Independent runtime-fingerprint comparison shows only trading_team/push_feishu.py changed; do not claim that snapshot contains the new gate. Verify the next scheduled registered snapshot before declaring this code recoverable from the persistent store.

entrypoint_inventory.current_daily_research_chain: trading_team.kimi_daily delegates to trading_team.push_feishu; direct daily push also enters trading_team.push_feishu, which now requires current dual-Paper evidence
entrypoint_inventory.scheduler_search: No reference to the other sender entrypoints was found in this project's checked-in current chain or the local LaunchAgents/Codex automation configuration searched at observation time.
entrypoint_inventory.boundary: This is not a claim that the repository has a single Feishu API caller or that manually invoked legacy scripts obey the versioned daily-report contract.

limits: This is a local behavioral gate, not a real Feishu delivery receipt or an M2 natural-session success.
The push entrypoint verifies Paper state but does not itself create a finalization run or substitute for checking the full workflow ledger and daily comparison.
Only the already authorized notification channel may be used after full current-version business evidence is independently verified.
